articles.title: Quick Start Guide
articles.summary: Get up and running with LANA AI in minutes
articles.content:
## Quick Start Guide

Welcome to LANA AI! This guide will help you get started quickly.

### Step 1: First Login

When you first log in to LANA AI, you'll see the dashboard. This is your central hub for all activities.

### Step 2: Complete Your Profile

Navigate to **Settings** → **Profile** and fill in your information:
- Name and contact details
- Profile picture (optional)
- Notification preferences

### Step 3: Create Your First Matter

1. Click **Matters** in the sidebar
2. Click **New Matter**
3. Enter matter details (name, client, type)
4. Click **Create**

### Step 4: Upload Documents

1. Open your newly created matter
2. Click the **Upload** button
3. Select files or drag and drop
4. Wait for processing to complete

### Step 5: Start Chatting

Navigate to the **Chat** page and ask LANA AI questions about your documents!

**Next Steps:**
- Explore data connectors to sync external files
- Set up workflows to automate tasks
- Invite team members to collaborate

articles.title: Your First Login
articles.summary: What to expect when you first log in
articles.content:
## Your First Login

When you first access LANA AI, here's what you'll encounter:

### The Login Screen

Enter the credentials provided by your administrator:
- **Username or Email**
- **Password**

If this is your first login, you may be prompted to:
1. Change your password
2. Set up multi-factor authentication (if enabled)
3. Review and accept terms of service

### The Dashboard

After logging in, you'll see:
- **Welcome banner** with your name
- **Quick stats** showing your matters, documents, and activity
- **Recent activity** feed
- **Quick actions** to create matters or upload documents

### Navigation

The sidebar provides access to:
- **Dashboard** - Overview and quick stats
- **Chat** - AI conversation interface
- **Matters** - Case and matter management
- **Data Connectors** - Integration with external systems
- **Sync Status** - Monitor data synchronization
- **AI Insights** - Analytics and predictions
- **Workflows** - Automation tools

### Getting Help

If you need assistance:
- Visit **Help & Support** in the sidebar
- Click the **?** icon for contextual help
- Contact your system administrator

articles.title: Navigating the Dashboard
articles.summary: Learn how to use the LANA AI dashboard effectively
articles.content:
## Navigating the Dashboard

The LANA AI dashboard is your command center.

### Dashboard Overview

**Top Bar:**
- Notification bell - View system notifications
- User menu - Access settings and logout

**Stats Cards:**
- Total Matters - Number of active matters
- Active Users - Team members online (admins only)
- Documents - Total documents processed
- Storage Used - Current storage consumption

**Recent Activity:**
- See what your team has been working on
- Track document uploads and edits
- Monitor AI usage

**System Status (Admins):**
- View health of backend services
- Monitor database, AI, and storage systems

### Keyboard Shortcuts

- `Ctrl/Cmd + K` - Quick search
- `Ctrl/Cmd + /` - Open help
- `Ctrl/Cmd + ,` - Open settings

### Customization

You can customize your dashboard by:
- Setting default views in Settings
- Choosing which stats to display
- Configuring notification preferences

articles.title: Using the Chat Interface
articles.summary: Learn how to interact with LANA AI's conversational interface
articles.content:
## Chat Interface

The LANA AI chat interface allows you to have natural conversations with your documents.

### Starting a Conversation

1. Navigate to the **Chat** page
2. Select a matter from the dropdown (optional but recommended)
3. Type your question in the input box
4. Press Enter or click Send

### What You Can Ask

**Document Analysis:**
- "Summarize the Smith contract"
- "What are the key terms in the lease agreement?"
- "Find all references to indemnification"

**Comparison:**
- "Compare version 1 and version 2 of the agreement"
- "What changed between drafts?"

**Research:**
- "Find relevant case law for this scenario"
- "What precedents support this argument?"

**Drafting:**
- "Draft a response letter to this complaint"
- "Create a summary of findings"

### File Drawer

Click the **file drawer icon** to:
- Select specific documents for the AI to reference
- Upload new files for immediate analysis
- View document metadata

### Chat History

All conversations are saved. You can:
- Review past conversations
- Continue previous threads
- Export chat transcripts

### Best Practices

- **Be specific** - Provide context and details
- **Use matter context** - Select the relevant matter for better results
- **Ask follow-ups** - The AI remembers conversation context
- **Verify important information** - Always review AI outputs

articles.title: Managing Matters
articles.summary: Organize your cases and legal matters efficiently
articles.content:
## Matter Management

LANA AI helps you organize matters (cases, clients, projects) with ease.

### Creating a Matter

1. Go to **Matters** page
2. Click **New Matter**
3. Fill in details:
   - Matter name
   - Client name
   - Matter type (litigation, transactional, etc.)
   - Status (open, pending, closed)
   - Assigned team members
4. Click **Create**

### Matter Dashboard

Each matter has:
- **Documents** - All files related to this matter
- **Activity** - Timeline of actions
- **Team** - Assigned users
- **Notes** - Internal comments
- **AI Insights** - Analytics and predictions

### Uploading Documents

Within a matter:
1. Click **Upload Documents**
2. Select files or drag-and-drop
3. Supported formats: PDF, DOCX, TXT, XLSX, PPTX
4. Wait for AI processing

### Organization

**Folders:**
- Create folders to organize documents
- Drag and drop to move files

**Tags:**
- Add tags for easy filtering
- Use predefined or custom tags

**Search:**
- Full-text search across all documents
- Filter by date, type, or tag

### Permissions

Control who can access each matter:
- Assign users with specific roles
- Set view-only or edit permissions
- Admins have full access to all matters

### Archiving

When a matter is complete:
1. Open the matter
2. Click **Actions** → **Archive**
3. Archived matters are hidden but searchable

articles.title: Uploading Documents
articles.summary: Learn how to upload and manage documents
articles.content:
## Document Upload

To upload documents to LANA AI:

### Upload Methods

**Drag and Drop:**
1. Navigate to a matter
2. Drag files from your computer
3. Drop them in the upload area

**File Picker:**
1. Click the **Upload** button
2. Browse and select files
3. Click **Open**

**Bulk Upload:**
- Select multiple files at once
- Upload entire folders (desktop app only)

### Supported Formats

- **Documents:** PDF, DOCX, DOC, TXT, RTF
- **Spreadsheets:** XLSX, XLS, CSV
- **Presentations:** PPTX, PPT
- **Images:** PNG, JPG, JPEG (with OCR)
- **Archives:** ZIP (extracts automatically)

### Processing

After upload, LANA AI:
1. **Extracts text** - OCR for images and scanned PDFs
2. **Chunks content** - Breaks into semantic sections
3. **Generates embeddings** - Creates vector representations
4. **Indexes** - Makes searchable

**Processing Time:**
- Small documents (< 10 pages): Seconds
- Medium documents (10-100 pages): 1-3 minutes
- Large documents (> 100 pages): 5-10 minutes

### Upload Limits

- Max file size: **100 MB** per file
- Max total storage: Set by your organization plan

### Troubleshooting

**Upload fails:**
- Check file size
- Ensure supported format
- Verify network connection

**Slow processing:**
- Large files take longer
- Server load may affect speed
- Check System Status page

articles.title: Data Connectors
articles.summary: Connect LANA AI to your existing systems
articles.content:
## Data Connectors

LANA AI can integrate with external systems to automatically sync documents.

### Available Connectors

- **Microsoft SharePoint**
- **Google Drive**
- **OneDrive**
- **Dropbox**
- **Box**
- More coming soon!

### Setting Up a Connector

1. Go to **Data Connectors** page
2. Click **Install Connector**
3. Select the connector type
4. Click **Authorize**
5. Sign in to the external service
6. Grant permissions
7. Configure sync settings:
   - Select folders/libraries to sync
   - Set sync frequency (hourly, daily, weekly)
   - Choose matter to sync to
8. Click **Save**

### OAuth Authorization

Most connectors use OAuth 2.0:
- You'll be redirected to the service login
- Sign in with your account
- Grant LANA AI read access
- You'll be redirected back

**Token Expiry:**
- OAuth tokens expire after 90 days (varies by service)
- Re-authorize when prompted

### Sync Process

When a connector syncs:
1. Fetches new/updated files from source
2. Downloads to LANA AI server
3. Processes documents (text extraction, embedding)
4. Indexes for search and AI

### Monitoring

View sync status:
- **Sync Status** page shows all connectors
- Last sync time
- Records processed
- Any errors

### Troubleshooting

**Connector not syncing:**
- Check OAuth token hasn't expired
- Verify permissions to source folders
- Review error logs in Sync Status

**Missing files:**
- Check folder selection
- Ensure files are in supported formats
- Verify file permissions in source system

articles.title: Can't Log In?
articles.content:
## Login Issues

If you're experiencing login problems, try these solutions:

### Incorrect Password

1. Verify Caps Lock is off
2. Try typing password in notepad first, then copy/paste
3. Click **Forgot Password** to reset

### Account Locked

After 5 failed login attempts, your account locks for 15 minutes.

**To unlock:**
- Wait 15 minutes
- Or contact your system administrator

### Email Not Found

- Verify you're using the correct email
- Check for typos
- Contact your admin to verify your account exists

### Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

**Not receiving code:**
- Check spam folder
- Verify phone number is correct
- Use authenticator app backup codes

**Authenticator app issues:**
- Ensure device time is synchronized
- Try regenerating codes in Settings

### Browser Issues

**Clear cache and cookies:**
1. Open browser settings
2. Clear browsing data
3. Select "Cookies" and "Cached images"
4. Clear from "All time"

**Try incognito/private mode:**
- Opens fresh session
- Bypasses extensions that may interfere

**Supported browsers:**
- Chrome 90+
- Firefox 88+
- Safari 14+
- Edge 90+

### Network Issues

**Can't reach server:**
- Verify you're on the correct network
- Check VPN connection if remote
- Ping server IP address
- Contact IT if firewall may be blocking

### Still Can't Log In?

Contact your system administrator with:
- Your email address
- Screenshot of error message
- Browser and operating system details

articles.title: Performance Issues
articles.summary: Fix slow loading and performance problems
articles.content:
## Performance Troubleshooting

If LANA AI is running slowly, try these solutions:

### Check Network Connection

**Test connection:**
1. Open System Status page
2. Check latency to server
3. Ideal: < 50ms, Acceptable: < 200ms, Slow: > 500ms

**Improve connection:**
- Use wired Ethernet instead of WiFi
- Ensure you're on same network as server
- Close bandwidth-heavy apps (video streaming, downloads)

### Browser Optimization

**Close unnecessary tabs:**
- Each tab uses memory
- Keep only essential tabs open

**Clear cache:**
1. Browser settings → Privacy
2. Clear cached images and files
3. Keep cookies to stay logged in

**Disable extensions:**
- Some extensions slow page load
- Try disabling ad blockers, privacy tools
- Re-enable one by one to identify culprit

**Update browser:**
- Use latest version
- Newer versions have performance improvements

### System Resources

**Check RAM usage:**
- LANA AI works best with 8GB+ RAM
- Close other memory-intensive apps

**Check CPU:**
- Background processes may be consuming resources
- Restart computer if it's been running for days

### Server Load

**Check system status:**
- Navigate to Admin → System Health
- High CPU/memory on server may slow responses

**Peak usage times:**
- Performance may be slower when many users are active
- Consider scheduling heavy tasks (bulk uploads) for off-hours

### Large Documents

**Processing time:**
- 100+ page PDFs take longer to process
- Scanned documents require OCR (slower)
- Be patient during upload processing

**Optimization:**
- Split very large documents into smaller files
- Use searchable PDFs instead of scanned images when possible

### AI Response Time

**Chat response delays:**
- Complex questions take longer (30-60 seconds normal)
- Large context (many documents) increases processing time
- Streaming output shows progress

**Optimize queries:**
- Be specific to reduce search scope
- Select specific documents in file drawer
- Use matter context to limit search space

### Contact Support

If performance issues persist:
- Note specific slow actions
- Check System Health page
- Report to administrator with details

articles.title: Connector Sync Errors
articles.content:
## Connector Sync Troubleshooting

When connectors fail to sync, follow these steps:

### Check Sync Status

1. Go to **Sync Status** page
2. Find your connector
3. View error details

### Common Errors

**"OAuth token expired"**
- Tokens expire after 60-90 days
- **Solution:** Re-authorize the connector
  1. Go to Data Connectors
  2. Click **Re-authorize**
  3. Sign in again

**"Permission denied"**
- LANA AI can't access the folder/library
- **Solution:** Check permissions
  1. Verify you have access to the source folder
  2. Ensure folder sharing is enabled
  3. Re-authorize with account that has access

**"Network error"**
- Can't reach external service
- **Solution:**
  1. Check internet connection
  2. Verify external service isn't down
  3. Check firewall isn't blocking
  4. Retry sync manually

**"Rate limit exceeded"**
- Too many API requests
- **Solution:** Wait and retry
  - Most services reset limits hourly
  - Reduce sync frequency if recurring

**"Invalid configuration"**
- Connector settings are incorrect
- **Solution:**
  1. Edit connector settings
  2. Verify folder/library paths
  3. Re-save configuration

### Manual Sync

Force an immediate sync:
1. Go to Sync Status
2. Find connector
3. Click **Sync Now**
4. Monitor progress

### Sync Logs

View detailed sync history:
1. Click connector name in Sync Status
2. View log entries
3. Look for:
   - Records processed
   - Records created
   - Records updated
   - Error messages

### Re-create Connector

If issues persist:
1. Delete the connector
2. Create a new one
3. Re-authorize
4. Re-configure settings

### Service-Specific Issues

**SharePoint:**
- Ensure site collection access
- Verify library permissions
- Check if library is locked

**Google Drive:**
- Verify Google account access
- Check if files are in "Shared with me" (requires different permissions)
- Ensure Drive API is enabled

**OneDrive:**
- Personal vs. Business accounts use different APIs
- Verify correct account type
- Check sharing settings

### Contact Support

If you can't resolve the issue:
- Export sync logs
- Screenshot error messages
- Note connector type and configuration
- Contact support with details

articles.title: Managing Users
articles.summary: Add, remove, and manage user accounts
articles.content:
## User Management

As an administrator, you can manage user accounts.

### Adding Users

1. Go to **Admin → Users**
2. Click **Add User**
3. Fill in details:
   - Email (required, used for login)
   - First and last name
   - Role (see Roles & Permissions)
   - Status (active, pending, suspended)
4. Click **Create**
5. User receives invitation email

### User Roles

- **System Admin** - Full system access, can manage everything
- **Org Admin** - Organization-wide access, can manage users and settings
- **Manager** - Can manage matters and team members
- **User** - Standard user, can create matters and upload documents
- **Viewer** - Read-only access

### Editing Users

1. Find user in list
2. Click **Edit**
3. Modify fields
4. Click **Save**

### Suspending Users

**Temporarily disable access:**
1. Edit user
2. Set status to **Suspended**
3. User cannot log in
4. Data remains intact

**Reactivate:**
1. Edit user
2. Set status to **Active**

### Deleting Users

⚠️ **Warning:** This permanently removes the user and may affect associated data.

1. Edit user
2. Click **Delete User**
3. Confirm deletion
4. User's matters and documents are preserved

### Password Reset

Help users who forgot passwords:
1. Find user
2. Click **Actions → Reset Password**
3. Choose method:
   - **Email reset link** (if email configured)
   - **Set temporary password** (provide to user)
4. User must change password on next login

### Bulk Operations

**Import users from CSV:**
1. Prepare CSV with columns: email, firstName, lastName, role
2. Go to Users page
3. Click **Import Users**
4. Upload CSV
5. Review and confirm

**Export users:**
1. Click **Export Users**
2. Download CSV
3. Contains all user data

### User Limits

Your organization plan includes a maximum number of users. To add more:
- Contact your account manager
- Upgrade your plan

### Best Practices

- **Use clear role assignments** - Don't give unnecessary permissions
- **Regular audits** - Review user list quarterly
- **Remove inactive users** - Suspend or delete accounts no longer needed
- **Document naming conventions** - Use consistent email format (@company.com)
- **Onboarding process** - Have a checklist for new users

articles.title: Roles & Permissions
articles.summary: Configure user roles and access control
articles.content:
## Roles & Permissions

LANA AI uses role-based access control (RBAC).

### Default Roles

**System Admin:**
- Full access to all features
- Manage users and organizations
- Configure system settings
- View audit logs
- Access all matters

**Org Admin:**
- Manage users within organization
- Configure organization settings
- View organization-wide statistics
- Access all matters in organization

**Manager:**
- Create and manage matters
- Assign users to matters
- View team activity
- Upload and manage documents

**User:**
- Create personal matters
- Upload documents to assigned matters
- Use chat and AI features
- View own activity

**Viewer:**
- Read-only access
- View assigned matters
- Cannot create, edit, or delete

### Creating Custom Roles

1. Go to **Admin → Roles**
2. Click **Create Role**
3. Name the role
4. Select permissions:

**Available Permissions:**
- `matters:read` - View matters
- `matters:write` - Create/edit matters
- `matters:delete` - Delete matters
- `documents:read` - View documents
- `documents:write` - Upload documents
- `documents:delete` - Delete documents
- `chat:access` - Use AI chat
- `admin:access` - Access admin panel
- `users:read` - View users
- `users:write` - Manage users
- `settings:read` - View settings
- `settings:write` - Modify settings
- `connectors:read` - View connectors
- `connectors:write` - Manage connectors
- `workflows:read` - View workflows
- `workflows:write` - Create workflows
- `workflows:execute` - Run workflows

5. Click **Save**

### Assigning Roles

**To individual users:**
1. Edit user
2. Select role from dropdown
3. Save

**Bulk assignment:**
1. Select multiple users
2. Click **Bulk Actions → Change Role**
3. Select new role
4. Confirm

### Matter-Level Permissions

In addition to roles, you can grant specific access per matter:

1. Open matter
2. Go to **Permissions** tab
3. Click **Add User**
4. Select user and permission level:
   - **Owner** - Full control
   - **Editor** - Can edit and upload
   - **Viewer** - Read-only
5. Save

### Permission Inheritance

- Org Admins automatically have access to all matters
- System Admins have access across all organizations
- Users only see matters they're assigned to

### Auditing Permissions

View who has access to what:
1. Go to **Admin → Audit Logs**
2. Filter by "permission changes"
3. See all role and access modifications

### Best Practices

- **Principle of least privilege** - Give minimum necessary permissions
- **Regular reviews** - Audit permissions quarterly
- **Document custom roles** - Maintain documentation of what each role can do
- **Test changes** - Verify permissions work as expected
- **Use matter permissions** - For sensitive matters, explicitly control access
